answer_1.quote: We propose a novel task of intent-specific counterspeech generation that aims to generate a counterspeech for a given hate speech and a desired counterspeech intent.

answer_2.quote: We employ Rouge and Meteor scores to evaluate the syntactic correctness of the generated counterspeech... we report BERTScore (BS) along with cosine similarity (SS)... compute category accuracy (CA) through an intent classification model.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a comprehensive human evaluation on a random subset of the generated counterspeeches... We ask our evaluators to rate the outputs on the following metrics: Independent CS (IC), Conditioned CS (CC), Adequacy (A), Toxicity (T) and Category Accuracy (CA).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rate each counterspeech on a 5‑point Likert scale for each metric (IC, CC, A, T, CA).
